Col_PickToTeleport.Source: Pick an alien-energy target to teleport to
Col_PickToTeleport.Translation: 选择一处外星能源以传送

Desc_Remote_Factory.Source: A factory-wide console. Build it and press E: from your HUB you can see the output of every machine plus total factory generation and draw, open any machine's own panel remotely, and pull its output straight out.
Desc_Remote_Factory.Translation: 全厂控制台。建造后按 E 打开：在枢纽里就能看到全部机器的产出与全厂发电/耗电，远程打开任意机器的原生面板，并直接取出产物。

Desc_UpgradeAccelerator.Source: Needs no power shards: once powered it applies a long-lasting production multiplier to itself. Capped at 2.5x -- beyond that the power draw outgrows the output and you are better off building another machine.
Desc_UpgradeAccelerator.Translation: 不需要能量碎片，通电后对自身施加一段长期产能倍率。上限 2.5 倍 —— 再高的话耗电增长会快过产出增长，不如直接多建一台。

Desc_UpgradeCloudDownloader.Source: The other half of the cloud storage system: pulls items back OUT of the central pool into its own buffer, one stack at a time. Open it like any storage container and grab what you need.
Desc_UpgradeCloudDownloader.Translation: 云端存储的另一半：把云端池里的物品拉回本地缓冲（每次一组），像普通仓库一样打开取用。与上传站配套使用。

Desc_UpgradeCloudFluidDownloader.Source: Press E to pick which fluid the cloud should send back out, then attach a pipe: the station feeds the selected fluid into the network as long as the cloud holds stock.
Desc_UpgradeCloudFluidDownloader.Translation: 按 E 选择云端要送回的流体，再接上管道：只要云端有存货，站点就会持续把选中的流体注回管网。

Desc_UpgradeCloudFluidUploader.Source: Attach a pipe and every cubic meter that arrives is uploaded into the cloud pool as its own fluid entry -- liquids and gases are accounted separately from solid items.
Desc_UpgradeCloudFluidUploader.Translation: 接上管道，流进来的每一方流体都会按物品类记入云端池 —— 液体与气体与固体分开记账、全厂共享。

Desc_UpgradePowerStorage.Source: A very large battery bank (1600 MWh). Stores the grid's surplus and releases it automatically during a shortfall. Once built, the factory-wide total shows at the top of the Smart Factory terminal panel.
Desc_UpgradePowerStorage.Translation: 一座超大容量电池组（1600 MWh）。存储电网盈余、在缺电时自动释放；建成后整座工厂的蓄电总量会显示在智能工厂终端面板顶部。

Desc_UpgradeStorage.Source: An 8 x 12 = 96 slot container for stockpiling a whole production line's intermediates. The Smart Factory picks it up in its scan, so you can check the contents from there.
Desc_UpgradeStorage.Translation: 通往云端存储的入口：把物品上传进位面存储站的聚合云端池，全厂共享。可被智能工厂扫到，在终端里直接查看存量。

EquipDesc_PortableTerminal.Source: A handheld Smart Factory. Craft it at a workbench and put it in an arm slot -- drawing it opens the factory console instantly, so you can check output, open a machine's own panel and pull items while standing at the miner instead of walking back to the HUB.
EquipDesc_PortableTerminal.Translation: 手持版智能工厂。在工作台制作后放进手臂槽，掏出来的瞬间就会打开全厂控制台 —— 不用回枢纽，站在矿机旁边就能看产出、开机器面板、取产物。

FluidPanel_NoFluids.Source: The cloud holds no fluids yet. Connect a Cloud Fluid Upload Station to a pipe.
FluidPanel_NoFluids.Translation: 云端暂无流体。先把云端液态上传站接到管道上，流体就会开始进云。

FluidPanel_NoTarget.Source: Open this panel on a Cloud Fluid Download Station.
FluidPanel_NoTarget.Translation: 请在云端液态下载站上打开本面板。

FluidPanel_Title.Source: Cloud Fluid Download Station · Pick a Fluid
FluidPanel_Title.Translation: 云端液态下载站 · 选择流体

Header_PrioritySwitch.Translation: 电源开关 · 优先级开关

MachineGroupMore.Source: …{0} more of this machine (showing the nearest {1})
MachineGroupMore.Translation: …另有 {0} 台同型机器（已显示最近的 {1} 台）

MilestoneDesc_UpgradeAccelerator.Source: Unlocks the Production Accelerator (up to 2.5x output, no power shards needed). It links up with the terminal and shows up in the terminal's machine list once built.
MilestoneDesc_UpgradeAccelerator.Translation: 解锁产能加速器（最高 2.5 倍产出，不需要能量碎片）。它与终端联动，建好后会出现在终端的机器列表里。

MilestoneDesc_UpgradeStorage.Source: Unlocks the Super Battery (1600 MWh, 400 MW charge/discharge). Connect it to the grid to store the surplus and release it automatically during a shortfall. Once built, the factory-wide total shows at the top of the Smart Factory terminal panel.
MilestoneDesc_UpgradeStorage.Translation: 解锁超级蓄电池（1600 MWh，充/放 400 MW）。接入电网即可存储全网盈余、在缺电时自动释放；建成后整座工厂的蓄电总量会显示在智能工厂终端面板顶部。

Milestone_Remote_Factory.Source: Unlocks the handheld Smart Factory and the High-Capacity Storage Unit. Equip the terminal from your inventory to browse every machine, operate them remotely, pull their output and teleport -- from anywhere in the world.
Milestone_Remote_Factory.Translation: 解锁智能工厂。把它建在枢纽旁边，即可在枢纽内查看全厂机器、远程操控并取出产物。

Milestone_UpgradeAccelerator.Translation: 智能工厂 · 产能加速器

Milestone_UpgradeStorage.Translation: 智能工厂 · 超级蓄电池

Msg_NoPrioritySupport.Source: This switch has no power-limit priority.
Msg_NoPrioritySupport.Translation: 该开关没有限电优先级

Msg_NotASwitch.Source: Target is not a power switch.

Msg_SwitchNotWired.Source: The switch is not wired on both ends, so this has no effect.
Msg_SwitchNotWired.Translation: 开关两端未接线，操作无效

Power_Readout.Source:
Gen {0} / {1} MW      Use {2} / {3} MW
Stored {4} / {5} MWh      Grids {6}
Power_Readout.Translation:
发电 {0} / {1} MW      耗电 {2} / {3} MW
储能 {4} / {5} MWh      电网 {6} 路

Reason_NoPlayerController.Source: Could not find the player controller.

Reason_ViewerReadOnly.Source: Only the console host can make changes (you are in view-only mode).
Reason_ViewerReadOnly.Translation: 只有控制台主控玩家可以操作（当前为观看模式）

RewardDescBattery.Source: Super battery: each level raises the battery's stored energy and its charge rate by 25%. Batteries link up into one grid-wide buffer.
RewardDescBattery.Translation: 超级蓄电池：每级使蓄电量与充电功率提升 25%。多台电池自动并入同一全网缓冲。

RewardDescCapacity.Source: Cloud capacity: the central pool now holds {0} stacks per item type (this level +2). The pool is shared by all four stations -- the solid upload station, the fluid upload station, the solid download station and the fluid download station.
RewardDescCapacity.Translation: 云端容量：中央云端池每类物品可存 {0} 组（本级 +2）。云端池由四类站共享 —— 云端储存上传站（固体）、云端液态上传站、云端存储下载站（固体）、云端液态下载站。

RewardDescFinalBoost.Source: Final reinforcement (shard route): all three tracks advance together. Each level additionally consumes Enhanced Power Shards and grants a 1.5x effect.
RewardDescFinalBoost.Translation: 最终强化（碎片路线）：三条轨同时推进。每级额外消耗强化能量碎片，换来 1.5 倍效果。

RewardDescFinalPlain.Source: Final reinforcement (standard route): all three tracks advance together along the original curve. Consumes no power shards.
RewardDescFinalPlain.Translation: 最终强化（常规路线）：三条轨同时推进，走原曲线、不消耗强化能量碎片。

RewardDescShard.Source: Enhanced power shard: each stage raises every machine's shard-slot potential ceiling (250% -> 300% -> 350% -> 400%) together with the per-shard increment. Power draw still follows the vanilla curve.
RewardDescShard.Translation: 强化能量碎片：每一阶段同时抬升全部机器的碎片插槽潜能上限（250% → 300% → 350% → 400%），并提高单块碎片的潜能增量。耗电仍按原版曲线。

Shard_Desc.Source: A refined shard for the vanilla shard slots. It overclocks exactly like a vanilla shard, but packs more potential per slot -- and the machines' potential ceiling rises with your MAM research (up to 400%: 3 shards = 1 + 3 x 1.0). Power draw follows the vanilla curve, so high overclocks burn coal fast.
Shard_Desc.Translation: 供原版能量碎片插槽使用的精炼碎片。插入后按原版逻辑超频，但单块潜能更高，且机器潜能上限随 MAM 产能研究提升（满级 3 块 = 400%）。电力消耗走原版曲线，高倍率时电费涨得很快。可投入资源回收站回收，也可在 AWESOME 商店用代价券购买。

Shared_ViewerMode.Translation: 共享中 · 主控：{0}（观看模式，无法操作）

Shared_YouAreOwner.Source: Sharing · you are the host ({0} others watching)
Shared_YouAreOwner.Translation: 共享中 · 你是主控（另 {0} 人在看）

ShopPowerShard_Desc.Source: Buy an Enhanced Power Shard with FICSIT coupons. One purchase = one shard; purchase as many as you need.
ShopPowerShard_Desc.Translation: 用 FICSIT 代价券购买强化能量碎片。每次购买 1 块，可重复购买。

Status_MachineCountRendered.Translation: {0} 台机器（列表只绘制最近的 {1} 台）

Status_MachineCountTruncated.Source: {0} machines listed (factory exceeds list cap - nearest shown)
Status_MachineCountTruncated.Translation: {0} 台机器（已达上限，结果被截断）

Status_NothingToPull.Source: There is no output to take

Status_TeleportFailed.Source: Teleport failed: the target is gone

Status_TeleportNoSafeLanding.Source: Teleport cancelled: no safe landing at the target -- its area is not loaded yet (deep inside a cave, for example). Move closer first.
Status_TeleportNoSafeLanding.Translation: 传送已取消：目标附近没有可站立的地面（该区域尚未加载，例如溶洞深处），请先靠近后再传送

SwitchState_NotWired.Source: Not wired — both ends of the switch must be connected to a power grid.
SwitchState_NotWired.Translation: 未接线 —— 开关两端都要连到电网才能生效

Title.Translation: 智能工厂 · 终端面板

TreeDesc_Remote_Factory.Source: Research the Smart Factory's upgrade buildings level by level in the MAM. Each level costs more than the last; the matching building scales automatically.
TreeDesc_Remote_Factory.Translation: 在 MAM 里逐级研究智能工厂的升级建筑。每级成本递增，对应建筑自动强化。
